summary: 3 film announcements, 2 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Inbetweeners Reunion Movie
film.announcement: Netflix is developing a reunion movie for The Inbetweeners with the original lead cast set to return.

film.title: Untitled Tiger Shroff Project
film.talent: Tiger Shroff, Abhishek Banerjee, Elvish Yadav; directed by Remo D'Souza
film.announcement: Tiger Shroff to star in Viccky Jain's VJ Frames launch title directed by Remo D'Souza, with Abhishek Banerjee and Elvish Yadav also set.

film.title: Barbie 2
film.talent: Margot Robbie, Ryan Gosling; director Greta Gerwig
film.announcement: The Barbie sequel has stalled as Warner Bros. CEO David Zaslav attempts to reach deals with director Greta Gerwig and stars Margot Robbie and Ryan Gosling over compensation.

tv.title: Lioness
tv.announcement: Taylor Sheridan is returning for an on-camera role in Lioness Season 3.

tv.title: New Girl
tv.announcement: Max Greenfield reveals he has seen scripts for a New Girl revival and states that as far as he knows, it is happening.
